items.title: Pretty Pastels
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Take your own outfit with a lot of soft beautiful colors to show off to others. Which one will you pick?

- 7 Pastel skins!
- Free skin: Lola
- Pretty, Fashion & Trendy!

By CubeCraft

items.title: Mob Spies
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These spy mobs are ready for any mission or heist handed to them! With all the latest in spy equipment available, they're prepared for anything!

- 8 skins!

This set includes the following:

- Creeper
- Enderman
- Slime
- Zombie
- Drowned
- Pig
- Spider
- Skeleton

items.title: Holograms
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Sporting the latest in hologram technology, these skins are sure to impress anyone that comes across them!

- 8 skins!
- A wide variety of different hologram designs and colors so you can pick the one that suits you best!

items.title: White And Black Style
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Join the classic white and black style!

- 12 Skins
- 1 Free Skin
- By UnderBlocks

items.title: Escape Sky Island
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Fight or fly with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Welcome to Sky Island, a welcome combination of parkour and world exploration where you'll get to put your skills to the test in a custom landscape made just for you. Do you have what it takes to survive? Can you live long enough to escape Sky Island?

items.title: Squids
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Bloop! Put on one of these funny squid costumes, ranging from an explorers outfit to a suit and tie.

+ 7 squid skins
+ Super random outfits

items.title: Ultra Trendy
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Look your coolest in these ultra trendy outfits! With neon designs and stylish clothing you're sure to stand out.

+ 10 teen skins
+ Unique designs

items.title: Secret Sinkhole Base
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Secret Sinkhole Base is here! but don't tell anyone! Check out this awesome base for your survival runs! Explore various rooms and find hidden treasures across the base! 

Includes: 
- House
- Secret base
- Enchantment room
- Armor and weapons room
- Automatic crop farm
- Mob farm
- Chest room
- Multiplayer and singleplayer
- Survival spawn
- And much more!

By KA Studios

items.title: Vivids!
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Want to stand out? These vibrantly colored skins are sure to make you the center of attention!

+ 14 teen skins
+ Super colorful designs

items.title: Cookies
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Who doesn't love cookies? It's time to dress up as one of these sugary snacks; in a variety of stylish outfits!

+ 7 wild cookie skins
+ Super random outfits

items.title: Cape Teens
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Do you want to have a cool cape? If you want it, we have designed an amazing skin pack for you! Choose your favorite skin now and dust the streets with your cape!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Blingy Fashion
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Are you ready to shine on the streets and be the coolest player? If you are ready, take a look at the 12 unique skins in this pack now! And choose your favorite skin and start showing off to everyone! Take your first step into a blingy world!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Rockstar Mobs
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
It is showtime! The world has been waiting to hear you play! It is time you join the band.

- 21 cool skins
- 1 free skin
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Street Demons
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
The streets are taken over by demons now! Form an alliance or face your demise. They don't show mercy!

- 21 demon skins
- 1 free skin
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Bubbles Skyblock
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Get ready to Skyblock on bubble islands! In these bubbles, which are different from each other, every material is available to improve your island. Don't forget to check the chests that have been added to the biomes.

- Includes skins.
- By Pixelusion & xfaddy

items.title: Volcano Secret Base
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Travel beneath an erupting volcano to discover your very own secret base! Explore all the base has to offer with enough space for all your friends!

- Farm room
- Chest room
- Indoor pool
- By ArgoStudios & Pixelusion

items.title: Tower Castle
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Always wanted to live in the highest tower? Then now is your chance! Climb the tower and reach the highest point of the world. On top of the tower you get the best view to prepare your adventure into the unknown. Good luck with your adventure!

+ Highest tower
+ Village
+ Knight skin

Created by StanDrijft and Mine-North

items.title: Elegant Pink and Black
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Pink is for everyone! Pick between these cute and cool skins and show off your pink and dark side with this epic collection of skins! Become famous with these cute outfits!

- 10 elegant outfits!
- 1 free skin!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Dome Walker
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description:
A group of explorers loved the jungle so much that they built a gigantic mechanical walker to carry a part of it with them while they explore. 
It comes equipped with:
- Farms with crops and animals
- A piece of jungle
- Enchanting room
- Storage room
- And many more

items.title: Ultimate Base Builder
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Build your own ultimate base with custom made machines and objects! You can build out your base with:

- Lasers
- Cameras
- Laptops
- More than 26 craftable machines to automate farming, mining and much more!
- Multiplayer friendly
- 1.17 supported

items.title: Emerald Temple
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Start your survival world off with this OP temple; filled with emeralds and powerful diamond tools!

- Make the temple your home or just harvest the resources!

items.title: Teen Button Hunt
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Are you ready to take on the challenge of an escape room as a TEEN? Surely nothing can go wrong... right?

-Explore a multitude of levels and try and find hidden buttons.
-Great for roleplaying with friends!
-Become a teen!
-Multiplayer Supportive!
-Custom Textures!

items.title: Emerald Mansion
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Live the rich life in this large emerald mansion! Stocked with plenty of emeralds, this is the perfect place to live for any emerald lover.

- The perfect spawn point for a survival world!

items.title: Modern Friends
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
The most elegant and modern style is among the young people, become one right now! 14 stylish outfits for you to delight in the city.

+ Perfect skins to play with friends
+ 2 free skins
